title: 🛫 Discover LZRU Ružomberok Airport in MSFS! 🌍
description:
Fly into the scenic Liptov region with the newly released LZRU Ružomberok Airport for Microsoft Flight Simulator! 🛩️ This detailed add-on features photorealistic buildings, custom ground textures, and handcrafted 3D models. Experience the charm of this non-public domestic airport, nestled near the High and Low Tatras. Pilot the versatile Cessna 172 Skyhawk, navigating through the meticulously crafted runways and taxiways. Whether you’re exploring the beautiful Slovak landscape or embarking on a cross-country journey, Ružomberok Airport offers an immersive experience for all aviation enthusiasts. Don’t miss out on adding this unique airport to your MSFS collection! ✈️✨

For a full overview of new airports and scenery enhancements added to the marketplace this week have a look at the video below:
